breakdown.description: The load is extended from the intended top-right segment to the whole top edge
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to apply the traction to the full top boundary. The ground truth corrects this, specifying the traction should be applied 'only on the top-right segment y = 1 with x > 0.5'. The agent's generated specification instead repeated the error, stating to apply the traction 'on the entire top boundary where y = 1, for all x > 0'.
